home.subtitle: Local startup & requirements
home.heading: Installation diagnostics
home.firstRun: SMN is not installed on this computer yet. You can set it up in a few clicks.
home.willPrepare: A dedicated database will be prepared only after you confirm installation.
home.noAutoSetup: No database or account is created when the server starts. Private routes require a valid session.

login.title: Sign in to Scrum Master Notebook
login.intro: Use the username or email address configured during installation.
login.pilotInfo: If you kept the pilot defaults during installation, the initial account is admin / admin. You must change the password before accessing the application.
login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in fifteen minutes.
login.unavailable: The SMN database is unavailable. Check that it is running, then try again.

diagnostic.configuration-missing: The SMN database connection has not been configured.
diagnostic.configuration-invalid: SMN must target a dedicated local PostgreSQL database.
diagnostic.database-missing: The SMN database does not exist yet. The upcoming installer will request confirmation before creating it.
diagnostic.connection-error: Could not connect to PostgreSQL. Check the local service and settings, then retry.
diagnostic.permissions-insufficient: The PostgreSQL account lacks the permissions required to inspect this installation.
diagnostic.server-version-unsupported: This PostgreSQL version has not been qualified for SMN I0. Check for version 18.
diagnostic.virgin: An empty SMN database was detected. You can review the installation preparation.
diagnostic.initialized: An existing SMN installation was found. Authentication will be required to access data.
diagnostic.schema-incompatible: The database schema is not recognized. No automatic changes will be applied.
diagnostic.installation-incomplete: The installation appears incomplete. Private data access remains blocked.
diagnostic.configuration-key-missing: This installation’s private key is missing. Do not reinstall: restore the original key or contact the administrator.

notFound.title: Access unavailable
notFound.message: Access is denied or this page does not exist.

settings.title: General settings
settings.intro: Customize this installation without changing its product, Agile mode or recorded history.
settings.fixedInfo: The Agile mode and reference product were set during installation. To change them, use a separate installation.
settings.localeInfo: Language used by screens already migrated under SMN-27. Other screens are being migrated.
settings.themeInfo: Preference stored; full theme support is planned for a future Story.
settings.countryInfo: Default country for future team members; past calendars, members and reports will not be recalculated.
settings.displayInfo: Display preferences are available for compatible modules. Settings affecting newly created data apply only to new data, without modifying history or archived documents.
settings.loadError: Could not load settings. No change was saved.
settings.conflict: These settings were changed in another tab. Reload the values before retrying.
settings.saveError: Could not save settings. Previous values were preserved.
settings.saved: Settings saved. Existing history was not modified.
settings.unchanged: No changes needed: settings are already up to date.
settings.network: Connection interrupted. Reload the values to confirm before retrying.

dashboard.unavailableDescription: SMN could not retrieve the product and team context. No data was changed.
dashboard.helperTitle: An interface that grows with you
dashboard.helperText: Features are added gradually. No fictional data is displayed.
dashboard.overviewDesc: Everything your team needs, in one place.
dashboard.noCycleIntro: Your installation is ready. The first cycle can be created on demand when {cycles} management becomes available.
dashboard.comingTitle: Cycle creation will be delivered in a future User Story
dashboard.pendingInfo: No cycle recorded — no pending review can be identified.
dashboard.goalsDesc: Cycle goals will appear here once entered.
dashboard.metricsDesc: Available metrics will be shown with their sources, without defaulting missing values to zero.
dashboard.eventsDesc: Upcoming ceremonies and meetings will appear here once scheduled.
dashboard.attentionDesc: Recorded risks, impediments and dependencies will appear here. Alerts are informative and will not change any status.
dashboard.reportDesc: You will find reviews and reports created from recorded team data here.
dashboard.footerHint: Unavailable values are never interpreted as zero results.

security.title: Account security
security.invalidate: All previous sessions will be invalidated. The current session will be renewed.
security.recoveryInfo: Set a recovery phrase separate from your password and backup phrase. If you forget your password, the local SMN command can use the phrase once. Without advance setup, recovery is impossible.
security.mismatch: The confirmation does not match or the values are identical.
security.saved: Recovery phrase saved: keep it in a safe place.
security.rejected: Setup denied. Check your password and recovery phrase.
security.network: SMN is not responding. No confirmation received.

password.welcome: Welcome, {username}. Before accessing the application, you must replace the password set during installation.
password.pilotInfo: The pilot accepts passwords of at least 4 characters. Choose one different from the previous password and difficult to guess.
password.mismatch: The password confirmation does not match.
password.same: Choose a password different from the previous one.
password.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
password.invalid: The current password is incorrect or the new password is not allowed.

accounts.title: User administration
accounts.intro: Create, view, enable or disable Scrum Master Notebook accounts.
accounts.createInfo: Only the Administrator and User profiles exist in the MVP. Creating an account does not create an Agile team member.
accounts.created: Account created. Share the initial secret privately with its owner. They must change it at first sign-in.
accounts.updated: Account updated. Previous sessions for this account have been revoked.
accounts.server: The SMN server is not responding.

errors.duplicate-account: This username or email address is already in use.
errors.invalid-input: Check the account details (password: at least 4 characters).
errors.last-admin: The last active Administrator cannot be disabled or demoted.
errors.self-protected: You cannot change your own role or disable your own account.
errors.forbidden: This action is restricted to a signed-in Administrator.
errors.service-unavailable: The SMN database is currently unavailable.

welcome.title: Install Scrum Master Notebook
welcome.intro: Scrum Master Notebook will now be installed. Enter the following details.
welcome.confirmRecovery: Confirm preservation of the previous attempt before continuing.
welcome.network: Cannot connect to the SMN server.
welcome.completeInfo: The SMN database, product, team and Administrator account have been created. Dashboard access is available once authentication is enabled.
welcome.dbExistingInfo: SMN will create only its dedicated 'smn' database on this server. Configuration will be stored locally in your Windows profile, with an encrypted password.
welcome.dbPortableInfo: SMN will create a private PostgreSQL instance with an automatically generated technical password.
welcome.pilotWarning: The default 'admin' password is suitable only for the local pilot. Change it before any real use.
welcome.confirmation: I confirm creation of the SMN database and data.
welcome.recoveryTitle: A previous installation attempt was detected.
welcome.recoveryBefore: SMN can move the incomplete data folder to
welcome.recoveryAfter: to preserve it and then create a new PostgreSQL instance. Existing files will not be deleted. This affects only the private SMN instance, not your usual PostgreSQL installation.
welcome.recoveryAccept: I authorize SMN to preserve its previous installation attempt and restart.
welcome.interrupted: Installation was interrupted. No data folder was deleted.
welcome.logBefore: For more details, consult the last lines of
welcome.logAfter: Do not share usernames, passwords or private paths.

errors.windows-required: Local installation is currently available only on Windows.
errors.manual-connection-configured: SMN already uses a manual PostgreSQL configuration.
errors.managed-config-invalid: The configuration of the existing SMN instance is invalid. No data has been deleted.
errors.managed-cluster-needs-recovery: A previous attempt created a PostgreSQL folder without completing setup. You can keep that folder and resume setup.
errors.managed-cluster-running: The SMN PostgreSQL server is still running and cannot be moved.
errors.managed-cluster-running-or-unclean: The PostgreSQL folder appears in use or contains an incomplete shutdown record. No action was taken.
errors.managed-cluster-unsafe: The PostgreSQL folder is not a standard SMN directory. Automatic recovery is not possible.
errors.managed-port-occupied: SMN's private PostgreSQL port (55432) is occupied.
errors.managed-pg-bind-denied: Windows prevented PostgreSQL from opening a local TCP port after multiple attempts. Check workstation network restrictions. Data was preserved.
errors.managed-pg-no-bindable-port: No permitted local TCP port was found for PostgreSQL. Check Windows restrictions.
errors.managed-pg-port-in-use: PostgreSQL could not open the requested port. SMN tried an alternative without changing other applications.
errors.managed-pg-permission-denied: Windows denied PostgreSQL access to a file or directory. Check Windows profile permissions; nothing was deleted.
errors.managed-pg-shared-memory: PostgreSQL could not reserve the required shared memory. Check its local log.
errors.managed-pg-locked: The PostgreSQL folder appears to be in use or locked. Recovery was not started.
errors.managed-pg-runtime-incomplete: A Windows component required for PostgreSQL is missing or could not load.
errors.managed-pg-config-invalid: PostgreSQL detected a startup configuration error. Its data remains unchanged.
errors.managed-pg-data-incompatible: PostgreSQL does not recognize the data in this folder. SMN will preserve it.
errors.managed-pg-start-failed: PostgreSQL could not start. More details are available in the local postgres.log file.
errors.postgres-archive-invalid: The PostgreSQL archive failed integrity verification.
errors.postgres-download-unavailable: The PostgreSQL files could not be downloaded.
errors.postgres-runtime-invalid: The portable PostgreSQL files are invalid.
errors.postgres-unreachable: The local PostgreSQL server did not respond on the specified port. Check that it is running.
errors.postgres-connection-failed: Cannot connect to PostgreSQL. Check the port and connection details.
errors.postgres-permission-denied: The PostgreSQL account lacks the required permissions.
errors.postgres-credentials-invalid: Enter a valid PostgreSQL username, password and port.
errors.createdb-required: The PostgreSQL account must have permission to create the SMN database.
errors.permissions-insufficient: Insufficient PostgreSQL permissions to create SMN tables.
errors.database-already-present: The SMN database already exists. Rerun diagnostics before making changes.
errors.schema-incompatible: The target database contains an unknown schema. No changes were made.
errors.installation-incomplete: A partial installation was detected. SMN will not reset it automatically.
errors.not-empty: The database already contains objects. SMN will not modify them.
errors.verification-failed: The database was written, but final verification failed. Do not reset it.
errors.installation-failed: Could not finish creating the tables or Administrator account.
errors.configuration-key-invalid: The local configuration key is invalid.
errors.already-running: An installation is already in progress.

legacySetup.pilotInfo: Administrator account: admin@locahost.com. No default password is provided.
legacySetup.password: Initial Administrator password (at least 14 characters, with letters and numbers)
legacySetup.confirm: I confirm creation of the dedicated SMN database, if required, and application of its initial schema.
legacySetup.success: Installation succeeded. Dashboard access will be enabled with SMN-14.
legacySetup.failed: Installation incomplete: {detail}. No session was created.
legacySetup.network: Connection unavailable. Check prerequisites and retry.

errors.invalid-input: Check names and password (at least 14 characters, with letters and numbers).
errors.configuration-missing: The SMN PostgreSQL connection is not configured.
errors.configuration-invalid: The configured connection is not a dedicated local SMN database.
errors.database-missing: The SMN database does not exist yet.
errors.createdb-required: This PostgreSQL account lacks CREATEDB permission. Use an authorized account or a dedicated pre-created SMN database.
errors.postgres-error: Could not connect to PostgreSQL, or permissions are insufficient. Check access and retry.
errors.permissions-insufficient: The PostgreSQL account lacks the required permissions in the SMN database.
errors.schema-incompatible: The database contains an unknown schema. No changes were made.
errors.installation-incomplete: A partial installation was detected. A second installation is not allowed.
errors.not-empty: The database is no longer empty. Reload the diagnostic before trying again.
errors.database-already-present: The database appeared between checks. Reload the diagnostic.
errors.installation-failed: Setup failed. Transaction changes were rolled back; consult the diagnostic.
errors.verification-failed: Writes completed but final verification failed. Do not reset; consult the diagnostic.
errors.forbidden: Invalid local token or request origin.
errors.confirmation-required: Explicitly confirm the installation before proceeding.

configuration.title: Configuration to complete
configuration.intro: These settings are optional. They never block your work and are not included in business reports.
configuration.error: Could not save the change. The previous status remains; please retry.

referenceCountry.title: Set a reference country
referenceCountry.description: This value is proposed for future team members. Saving the country automatically completes the task.

recoveryPhrase.title: Prepare a recovery phrase
recoveryPhrase.description: Protect administrator access. Successfully saving the phrase automatically completes the task.

displayPreferences.title: Review display preferences
displayPreferences.description: Review your language and theme. Completion remains manual because defaults do not prove personalization.
